description.value:
You damp your chakra signature down to the level of a civilian. Sensors lose precise lock on you, and detection jutsu of equal or lower rank treat you as if you had no chakra signature at all.

You gain a +3 status bonus to Stealth checks against creatures using non-visual chakra senses, and any sensor jutsu of rank lower than this spell's rank that targets you must attempt a counteract check against your spell DC to perceive you at all.

Casting a jutsu of rank 1 or higher ends this jutsu immediately.

Heightened (+2) Increase the suppression effect's threshold rank by 1.
